where: Dimglass Coast (the first road out of town)
mood: The road that teaches you to wander — brisk, salt-aired, optimistic; the hometown tune breaking into a stride.
core_styles: plucked harp arpeggios like chiming buoys
bouncy synth bass rocking root and fifth
light brushy snare and soft kick like lapping foam
adventurous walking theme for the first route of a journey

sections.name: Intro
sections.text: {a bold, bright opening call that announces the open road: a rising fanfare on the lead over a drum pickup, landing on a held chord that springs straight into the walking theme}

sections.name: Main Theme
sections.text: {the walking melody, hummable and springy, front and centre, steady stride in the bass}

sections.name: Main Theme Reprise
sections.text: {the same melody again with a bell counter-line glinting on the offbeats, a little fuller}

sections.name: Bridge
sections.text: {contrast: the sea opens out, a wistful turn to E minor, longer notes reaching over the dark water, the drums thin to a brush, then a lift back toward the theme}

sections.name: Main Theme Return
sections.text: {the walking melody returns in full stride; the last bar leads straight back into the main theme}
styles: seamless loop back to the start of the theme
